world.h: Iran says US 'not serious' about talks
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: Iran says the US is 'not serious' about talks, and a vessel is on fire off Iraq's coast.
world.title: Iran says US is ‘not serious’ about talks; vessel on fire off Iraq’s coast

national.h: Eric Bauza, modern voice of Bugs Bunny, dies at 46
national.b: Bauza voiced Looney Tunes characters and roles in 'Puss in Boots,' 'Muppet Babies' and 'Avatar: The Last Airbender,' winning three Children's and Family Emmy Awards.

national.h: Visa ban leaves immigrant families stuck abroad
national.b: A court ruling has not ended the wait for thousands of immigrants caught by the Trump administration's January ban on processing immigrant visas for citizens of 75 countries, including some whose visas were already approved.

national.h: Cybersecurity CEO indicted in ransomware scheme
national.b: Zohar Pinhasi of Florida-based MonsterCloud is accused of telling ransomware victims he could recover their files without paying hackers, when he actually paid the ransom and charged them a hefty fee on top.
national.title: Cybersecurity CEO Indicted for Allegedly Scamming Millions From Ransomware Victims

politics.h: Comey charged for a third time
politics.b: Newly unsealed court documents revealed new Justice Department charges against former FBI director James Comey, a longtime Trump critic. Comey called it 'an appalling abuse' of the department.
politics.title: Trump administration charges former FBI Director James Comey for the third time

politics.h: Judge: DOJ illegally fired Comey's daughter
politics.b: A federal judge ruled Monday that the Justice Department unlawfully fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey, a longtime Manhattan prosecutor who argued she was dismissed because of her father.
politics.title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey

politics.h: Six citizens sue Trump over White House media bans
politics.b: The Knight First Amendment Institute filed suit in federal court in New York arguing that barring journalists violates the public's right to independent reporting about its government.

international.h: Pope Leo to proceed with Latin America trip
international.b: After a post-surgery checkup, the Vatican confirmed the pope will keep his ambitious trip program unchanged. His physician said there is no medical reason to prevent the trip.
international.title: Following post-surgery checkup, Pope Leo will proceed with Latin America trip, Vatican confirms

international.h: Jordan strikes Syria after deadly church attack
international.b: Jordan's armed forces said Monday's air strikes targeted groups in southeastern Syria linked to the gunmen who killed nine people at a church in Karak, killing and wounding many of their members.
international.title: Jordan strikes Syria after church attack, killing at least seven people

international.h: Saudi-led coalition says it hit Houthi missile sites
international.b: Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki said its forces destroyed four ballistic missile launchers and five tunnels the Houthis used to store missiles, as the group claimed attacks on infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and Yemen.
international.title: Saudi-led coalition says it struck Houthi missile facilities

international.h: China's Communist Party elite open plenum
international.b: Roughly 300 Central Committee members began a closed-door plenum Monday as Xi Jinping pushes for greater loyalty from officials, about a year before he is widely expected to secure a fourth term as party leader.

international.h: Bolsonaro rejects Lula's Brazil election win
international.b: Lula was declared winner with 51.8% of the vote, but Flávio Bolsonaro refused to concede and asked for the results to be annulled after a chaotic evening at some polling places following a last-minute two-hour voting extension.

international.h: Jordan arrests three suspects in church attack
international.b: Security forces arrested three suspects in the deadly attack on a church in Karak after they were found hiding in an abandoned house and refused to surrender, wounding them in a firefight, Jordan's Public Security Directorate said.

business.h: Volvo cuts jobs, blames Chinese competition
business.b: The Swedish automaker is cutting 2,500 jobs, about 6% of its workforce, after losing more than $500 million last quarter. Its shares plunged more than 20%.
business.title: Volvo is limping out of a bruising quarter. The carmaker's CEO blames Chinese competition.

business.b: The AI company filed with the SEC for an IPO under the ticker ANT that reports say could value it at $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion. The prospectus did not say how many shares it will offer or at what price.
The electronics retailer is betting on a return to retro and analog tech ahead of the holiday shopping season, managing director Kevin Hamann told Marketplace.

science.h: AI models are transforming hurricane forecasts
science.b: Google DeepMind's AI model correctly predicted Hurricane Isaias would hit the western Florida Panhandle when conventional models pointed toward Louisiana. Meteorologist Michael Lowry calls it the best-performing model ever seen.

sports.h: Ohio State stays No. 1 as upsets shake rankings
sports.b: Ohio State remains atop CBS Sports' Power Rankings over Miami. Top-10 teams have lost 11 times in three weeks, tied for the most in any three-week regular-season stretch since the AP poll began in 1936.

sports.h: Thunder's Jalen Williams leaves on stretcher
sports.b: Williams suffered a gruesome lower left leg injury late in Oklahoma City's win over the Clippers. Coach Mark Daigneault said the team had no immediate update on his status.

sports.h: Watson's late drive keeps Browns in first place
sports.b: Deshaun Watson engineered another fourth-quarter game-winning drive in Cleveland's 27-24 win over Tennessee, his fifth this season, as the Browns sit in first place in their division.
J.J. McCarthy impressed in his first start for New York after his trade from the Vikings, and Cam Skattebo responded emphatically to his Week 6 benching as John Harbaugh's Giants keep rolling.

sports.h: Only three undefeated FBS teams remain
sports.b: Miami, Utah and UCLA are the last unbeaten teams in FBS, a historic low. The last time major college football had only three undefeated teams through Oct. 24 was in 1977.
Baylor fired Dave Aranda, who won the 2021 Big 12 title but posted four losing records in six full seasons.

sports.h: WNBA sets Finals Game 6 for Thursday lunchtime
sports.b: Game 6 will be played at State Farm Arena at 12:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, Oct. 29, a decision announced just hours before Game 5 tipped off.
sports.title: WNBA Finals' Game 6 scheduling debacle is an embarrassing end to a historic season

local.h: Pressure grows on Mamdani over specialized schools
local.b: Former schools chancellor David Banks, Public Advocate Jumaane Williams and three borough presidents are expected to call Tuesday for admissions reform at the city's specialized high schools.
local.title: Pressure grows on Mamdani to reform admissions to NYC specialized high schools

local.h: Council to weigh juvenile jail changes
local.b: The NYC Council will consider changes to juvenile detention as assaults and overcrowding rise. A mother says her son was attacked by other teens while held at Horizon in the Bronx.
local.title: NYC Council to weigh changes to juvenile jails as assaults and overcrowding rise

local.h: NYers face higher health costs as enrollment opens
local.b: New Yorkers without employer coverage can shop for 2027 plans on the state marketplace starting Nov. 1, and many will feel the effects of federal health spending cuts, including reduced eligibility for the Essential Plan.
local.title: What NYers can expect as open enrollment for health insurance begins

local.h: Judge halts overnight work at Chinatown jail site
local.b: A Manhattan Supreme Court judge temporarily halted after-hours construction on the new Chinatown jail after residents sued over sleep disruption, another setback for the city's plan to replace Rikers Island.
local.title: Judge temporarily halts overnight construction at NYC’s Chinatown jail

periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 44. Northeast wind around 6 mph.

periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 63. Light and variable wind becoming south 5 to 7 mph in the afternoon.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 54. South wind 5 to 7 mph becoming southwest after midnight.

localgood.h: Rockefeller tree is a 76-foot upstate spruce
localgood.b: The Norway spruce from West Edmeston will be cut Nov. 5, arrive Nov. 7 and be lit Dec. 2 with more than 50,000 LED lights and a Swarovski star.
localgood.title: Rockefeller Center's 2026 Christmas tree is a 76-foot spruce from Upstate New York

localgood.h: East Brooklyn NYCHA homes get $636M upgrade
localgood.b: Nearly 3,000 residents of the Reid & Park Rock developments now live in renovated apartments with new kitchens, bathrooms and modernized heating and ventilation, NYCHA said.
localgood.title: In East Brooklyn, aging NYCHA homes get a $636M upgrade
